correctness.rationale: The source equivalence between pure two-periodic laws on I and nonfixed positive two-cycles of f was checked. The derivative factorization is exact. For theta<1 monotonicity excludes a two-cycle; at theta=1 the map is constant. For theta>1, the exact positive-coefficient identity NQ-2u(theta^2-1)P=R gives -1<g'<0 in logarithmic coordinates, and the mean value theorem excludes a genuine two-cycle. The bundled rational checker corroborates the algebra but is not used as the universal proof.
